sections.heading: Step 1: Create a Spring Boot Starter Project

items: Open Spring Tool Suite (STS).
Click: File -> New -> Other -> Spring Starter Project
Click Next.
Project Name: FirstSpringApp
Build Tool: Gradle (Buildship)
Configure packaging options (JAR/War)
Click Next

sections.heading: Step 3: Select Spring Boot Version and Dependencies

items: Choose a Spring Boot version (latest stable recommended)
Select Web dependency under the Web category
Click Finish
A ready-to-run Spring MVC Web Application is generated.
